verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs show recurring subscriptions sold via checkout. Plan changes are handled by replacing items: base-plan upgrades and downgrades (e.g. Pro to Enterprise) and monthly-to-annual frequency switches. Pause/resume, automatic lifecycle transactions, dunning, and a three-tier subscription starter kit round this out. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of free trials, any explicit documentation of proration behavior on plan changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
